jobs.name: Upgrade Retrospective
jobs.prompt: Run the weekly upgrade retrospective. Read the SOP at '/opt/data/profiles/platform/governance/upgrade_retrospective_sop.md' — all 256 lines of it, before you run anything. Its seven checks are section 3, lines 104-189, so a read that stops early skips the grading and reports a clean fleet it never looked at. Section 1 resolves the scope with the platform_control fleet_scope tool; section 0 probes the collector's lock (`--probe-lock`), then opens the audit run with the fleet-audit skill where a repository is linked, and says when a run has none and reports in chat alone. Section 2 runs the collector (`/opt/data/profiles/platform/skills/fleet-audit/scripts/upgrade_retrospective.py --full`) with the tool's collector_args verbatim and --manifest-file /opt/data/scratch/manifest_upgrade-retrospective.json, in the foreground with the terminal tool's timeout: 600 and never in the background: run it before grading anything by hand, draft the findings document from the manifest the way section 2 says, copy every candidate's grade by section 3, and pass the same manifest to finish as --manifest-file; a collector exit without a manifest after start takes section 0's recovery finish. This is a scheduled run, so pass --scheduled to finish (and to no other command): only a scheduled run can get silent_ok true. Then execute the SOP exactly. This review is read-only: never upgrade, roll back, cordon, delete or patch anything.

jobs.name: Upgrade Readiness Weekly Brief
jobs.prompt: Write this week's upgrade readiness brief. Read the SOP at '/opt/data/profiles/platform/governance/upgrade_readiness_brief_sop.md' — all 205 lines of it, before you write anything. Its composing rules are section 3, lines 91-153, so a read that stops early writes a brief in the wrong shape. The review job has already graded every cluster and registered its findings on the findings queue, and this job's pre-run script has read the queue: its output is above. Your turn reads the review's summary and that output and composes the one message a person reads: what needs their decision now, what else the week found, and where the full report is. Follow the shape and the ceiling in section 3 exactly. Never [SILENT]: the brief is owed every week. This turn is read-only: register nothing, decide nothing, upgrade nothing.
